start_game_wakeup.text: You awake, in a calm forest grove next to a river.
start_game_wakeup.speaker: narrator

start_game_wakeup_2.text: Something seems strange about this. Were you here before?
start_game_wakeup_2.speaker: narrator

start_game_wakeup_3.text: Use the left + right arrow keys to move
start_game_wakeup_3.speaker: guide

guide_explain_interact.speaker: guide
guide_explain_interact.text: When you can interact with an object, you'll see an icon above it.

guide_explain_interact_2.speaker: guide
guide_explain_interact_2.text: Press the space bar or enter key to interact with it.

guide_explain_interact_3.speaker: guide
guide_explain_interact_3.text: Certain items require certain party members to be able to interact with them.

narrator_explain_recruit.speaker: narrator
narrator_explain_recruit.text: You get the feeling you've said something right. A good thing too, you're probably going to need some friends.

guide_explain_recruit.speaker: guide
guide_explain_recruit.text: When you can recruit a character, you'll see an icon above them.

guide_explain_recruit_2.speaker: guide
guide_explain_recruit_2.text: Press the R key to recruit them to your party.

guide_explain_recruit_3.speaker: guide
guide_explain_recruit_3.text: You can only have four characters (including yourself) in your party at a time.

forest_enter.speaker: Rowyn
forest_enter.text: If you keep going straight, this path will eventually take you to Lunara Village.

forest_enter_2.speaker: Rowyn
forest_enter_2.text: It's quite far. Hopefully we can make it before dark.

forest_enter_3.speaker: Rowyn
forest_enter_3.text: The veil is already thin in these woods. Magic is easy, and things sometimes slip thorugh from the other side.

forest_enter_4.speaker: Rowyn
forest_enter_4.text: At night, the barrier is even weaker, and the things that come are less friendly...

forest_enter_5.speaker: Rowyn
forest_enter_5.text: Let's just... go quickly, ok? We can talk about it back at the village.

guide_dialog_prompts.speaker: narrator
guide_dialog_prompts.text: You notice that the friendly young woman who's following you, is trying to get your attention.

guide_dialog_prompts_2.speaker: guide
guide_dialog_prompts_2.text: Dialog prompts appear above the heads of party members

guide_dialog_prompts_3.speaker: guide
guide_dialog_prompts_3.text: Each has a number assigned to it. Press that number key to start a conversation

mist_entry_branch.text: A heavy mist drifts across the river, obscuring the way ahead...
mist_entry_branch.speaker: narrator

mist_with_rowyn_explain.speaker: Rowyn
mist_with_rowyn_explain.text: Careful. That mist isn’t natural. It’s leaking through from the spirit world.

rowyn_protect_from_mist.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_protect_from_mist.text: I know a spell that can strengthen the veil around me a little. Maybe it will clear the mist?

abilities_menu.speaker: guide
abilities_menu.text: Press A to open the Abilities menu.

rowyn_left_in_mist.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_left_in_mist.text: It's fine if you want to go on your own, but don't leave me in there!

rowyn_mist_unfollowed.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_mist_unfollowed.text: Aggressive spirits won't follow us into the mist!

rowyn_mist_unfollowed_2.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_mist_unfollowed_2.text: If I clear the mist with my spell, they might follow again. But without the spell, we can't see what's in here...

splitpath_bridge_just_rowyn_from_left.speaker: Rowyn
splitpath_bridge_just_rowyn_from_left.text: If you keep going straight, the path will eventually take you to Lunara Village.

splitpath_bridge_just_rowyn_from_right.speaker: Rowyn
splitpath_bridge_just_rowyn_from_right.text: Lunara Village is back the other way.

splitpath_warning_not_night.speaker: Rowyn
splitpath_warning_not_night.text: The forest across the river is far too dangerous, even during the day. This path is longer, but we can still make it if we hurry.

splitpath_warning_night.speaker: Rowyn
splitpath_warning_night.text: The forest across the river is far too dangerous, especially at night.

splitpath_bridge_mira.speaker: Mira
splitpath_bridge_mira.text: If we cross the river here, the path to Lunara Village is much quicker

splitpath_bridge_mira_2.speaker: Mira
splitpath_bridge_mira_2.text: It's not that dangerous, we just need to be careful...

splitpath_bridge_mira_3.speaker: Mira
splitpath_bridge_mira_3.text: ... and anyway, it's already too late to make it by the long path...

mira_longpath_1.speaker: Mira
mira_longpath_1.text: This is slower. If we go back to the bridge and cross the river, it’s quicker.

rowyn_disagree_1.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_disagree_1.text: It’s safer this way. Faster doesn’t help if we don’t make it there.

mira_longpath_2.speaker: Mira
mira_longpath_2.text: We’re wasting time. The bridge was right there. We should turn back now.

rowyn_disagree_2.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_disagree_2.text: I’m not crossing into a thinner veil at dusk. Not for a shortcut.

mira_longpath_3.speaker: Mira
mira_longpath_3.text: I told you. The other way is faster...

rowyn_disagree_3.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_disagree_3.text: And I told you: I won’t risk the river path. Not with the veil like this.

mira_leaves_low_alignment.speaker: Mira
mira_leaves_low_alignment.text: I can’t go any further with you....

rowyn_wisp_intro_3.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_wisp_intro_3.text: I didn't realise it was so late.

rowyn_wisp_intro_5.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_wisp_intro_5.text: It can be dangerous to let these spirits touch you, but they're not agressive.

rowyn_wisp_intro_6.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_wisp_intro_6.text: I'm used to the effect they have on me, but you might feel sleepy or disoriented if one gets too close.

rowyn_wisp_intro_7.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_wisp_intro_7.text: So don't worry about me, but whatever you do, don't stop until you're past it.

rowyn_diversion_4.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_diversion_4.text: I never stay in the forest this late. The veil is starting to tear. We'll have to find another way around.

rowyn_diversion_5.speaker: guide
rowyn_diversion_5.text: Exits are marked with an arrow. Press the UP or DOWN arrow key when near an exit to move to another area

rowyn_nightfall.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_nightfall.text: It's night already... I hoped we'd be back to the village by now.

rowyn_nightfall_2.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_nightfall_2.text: With the veil so thin, it's extremely dangerous out here.

rowyn_nightfall_3.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_nightfall_3.text: Some spirits can be aggressive, and there are things that will play tricks on our senses.

rowyn_nightfall_4.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_nightfall_4.text: Even just get too close to a rift in the veil, and you might slip through, or fall asleep and never wake up.

rowyn_nightfall_5.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_nightfall_5.text: Be careful, is what I'm saying. Stay on course, and let's get out of the forest as quick as possible.

mira_nightfall_1.speaker: Mira
mira_nightfall_1.text: The route through the forest across the river is much quicker...

rowyn_barrier.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_barrier.text: Monuments like these are littered throughout the forest. The stories say they've been here since before Lunara village was even founded.

rowyn_barrier_2.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_barrier_2.text: There are different types. Some are maybe just decorative, but some are clearly magical.

rowyn_barrier_3.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_barrier_3.text: I've been studying these ones, to try and copy their magic. They can generate a sort of invisible barrier.

rowyn_barrier_4.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_barrier_4.text: You can switch them on and off just by touching them, but these ones will reset back to how they were after a short time.

mira_barrier_5.speaker: Mira
mira_barrier_5.text: It's holding back that creature... It looks very dangerous...

rowyn_barrier_5.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_barrier_5.text: Probably best not to switch this one off... Let's try to find another way around.

mira_barrier_6.speaker: Mira
mira_barrier_6.text: There IS another way... Across the river...

mira_barrier.speaker: Mira
mira_barrier.text: I really don't think it's safe to go this way...

mira_barrier_2.speaker: Mira
mira_barrier_2.text: That barrier is blocking the way, but if we open it, that thing will get to us...

mira_barrier_3.speaker: Mira
mira_barrier_3.text: If we go back and cross the river...

mira_barrier_4.speaker: Mira
mira_barrier_4.text: Maybe you can go this way, and we'll go that way...

guide_drop_npc.speaker: guide
guide_drop_npc.text: You can drop a character from your party by holding SHIFT and pressing their number.

rowyn_follower_2.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_follower_2.text: Be careful, there's something strange about that spirit.

rowyn_follower_3.speaker: Rowyn
rowyn_follower_3.text: It feels more aggressive than the normal type. I think it might attack if we get too close.

mira_follower_3.speaker: Mira
mira_follower_3.text: That type of spirit can track your aura. Once it starts following you, it's very difficult to lose it...

mira_forest_north_2_event_3_mira_not_kno.speaker: Mira
mira_forest_north_2_event_3_mira_not_kno.text: New prey... without even a lure to attract them...

mira_forest_north_2_event_5.speaker: Mira
mira_forest_north_2_event_5.text: You'll keep us fed for a while...

snap_out.text: Snap out of it! Don't you remember us?

kill.text: Are you going to kill us, like you did all those others?

trapped.text: I think you're trapped here, more than we are

bodies.text: How many bodies are there inside?

suffer.text: How long did you make them suffer?

boy.text: The young boy, how much did he suffer?

another.text: Maybe we can find another way to sustain you?

long.text: How long have you been here?

spirits.text: Are you responsible for all the spirits in the forest?

daylight.text: We can just wait until daylight

shrine_back_encounter_3.speaker: shrine_spirit
shrine_back_encounter_3.text: I do not hide from the sun... like lesser spirits

shrine_back_encounter_home_1.speaker: Rowyn
shrine_back_encounter_home_1.text: But you only leave the northern forest at night

shrine_back_encounter_5.speaker: shrine_spirit
shrine_back_encounter_5.text: I will consume you... as I did her...

feast.text: And now? Do you still feast?

shrine_back_encounter_place_6.speaker: shrine_spirit
shrine_back_encounter_place_6.text: They worshipped me... fed me... long ago...

shrine_back_encounter_place_7.speaker: shrine_spirit
shrine_back_encounter_place_7.text: It has been so long... since I was full...

people.text: How many people have you killed?

woman.text: The woman in the engravings looks different

shrine_front_left_encounter_1_a.speaker: shrine_spirit
shrine_front_left_encounter_1_a.text: In here... you are my prey...

forest_north_encounter_what_1.speaker: shrine_spirit
forest_north_encounter_what_1.text: I'm Mira... don't you recognise me?

forest_north_encounter_what_2.speaker: Rowyn
forest_north_encounter_what_2.text: Was there ever a real Mira?

forest_north_encounter_remember_1.speaker: shrine_spirit
forest_north_encounter_remember_1.text: Of course I remember... I brought you here...

forest_north_encounter_trapped_2.speaker: rowyn
forest_north_encounter_trapped_2.text: But you can't leave the forest

forest_north_encounter_trapped_1.speaker: shrine_spirit
forest_north_encounter_trapped_1.text: This is my home... my domain...

forest_north_encounter_trapped_3.speaker: rowyn
forest_north_encounter_trapped_3.text: You can't even leave this shrine during the day

forest_north_encounter_trapped_4.text: How long has it been since you've seen the outside world? The sun?
forest_north_encounter_trapped_4.speaker: rowyn

forest_north_encounter_trapped_9.speaker: shrine_spirit
forest_north_encounter_trapped_9.text: I have enough prey right here... right now...

first.text: You possessed someone else before Mira?

shrine_back_encounter_priestess_2.speaker: rowyn
shrine_back_encounter_priestess_2.text: But there's been no-one living here for hundreds of years

shrine_back_encounter_priestess_4.speaker: shrine_spirit
shrine_back_encounter_priestess_4.text: Then... I had no need for a lure...

killed.text: How many people have you killed?

forest_shrine_front_right_encounter_5.speaker: shrine_spirit
forest_shrine_front_right_encounter_5.text: They were all just prey... like you...

mira.text: How long have you used Mira to lure prey?

forest_shrine_front_right_encounter_6.speaker: shrine_spirit
forest_shrine_front_right_encounter_6.text: Your names are meaningless to me... you are just my food...

parents.text: Do you remember your parents, Mira?

forest_shrine_front_right_encounter_11.speaker: mira
forest_shrine_front_right_encounter_11.text: I don't want to forget again...

forest_shrine_front_right_pendant_1.speaker: shrine_spirit
forest_shrine_front_right_pendant_1.text: That is nothing... and she remembers nothing...

forest_shrine_front_right_mira_1.speaker: shrine_spirit
forest_shrine_front_right_mira_1.text: She is perfect... she has brought me so many meals...

break.text: You can stop it Mira! Break free!

remember.text: Do you remember killing them, Mira?

forest_shrine_front_right_mira_3.speaker: shrine_spirit
forest_shrine_front_right_mira_3.text: I will consume you... and she will remember nothing...

etiram_skeleton_scene_3.speaker: etiram
etiram_skeleton_scene_3.text: Mira! Come away from that thing!

etiram_skeleton_narrator_1.speaker: narrator
etiram_skeleton_narrator_1.text: You've seen some strange things so far, but was that a ghost?

etiram_skeleton_rowyn_1.speaker: rowyn
etiram_skeleton_rowyn_1.text: An echo. The last moments of this man, forever playing out in the spirit world.

etiram_skeleton_rowyn_2.speaker: rowyn
etiram_skeleton_rowyn_2.text: He said Mira's name. He knew her, maybe?

etiram_skeleton_rowyn_3.speaker: rowyn
etiram_skeleton_rowyn_3.text: But this body is so old. Its been here for a very long time.

etiram_skeleton_narrator_2.speaker: narrator
etiram_skeleton_narrator_2.text: You see a sealed leather tube laying next to the skeleton. Old and fragile, but still intact. You look inside, and find...

caira_skeleton_scene_2.speaker: caira
caira_skeleton_scene_2.text: Mira! Mira! Why did you bring us here?

caira_skeleton_scene_4.speaker: caira
caira_skeleton_scene_4.text: Why? Why? Why did you leave camp?

caira_skeleton_rowyn_2.speaker: rowyn
caira_skeleton_rowyn_2.text: Is there anything else here? Anything that might give us more information?

caira_skeleton_second.speaker: narrator
caira_skeleton_second.text: You look over the long-decomposed remains of a woman

caira_skeleton_second_1.speaker: narrator
caira_skeleton_second_1.text: Apart from bones and crumbling scraps of clothing, the only thing here is a tarnished necklace with a blue stone.

caira_skeleton_second_rowyn.speaker: rowyn
caira_skeleton_second_rowyn.text: I don't feel right taking things from the dead. Maybe we should leave it alone.

caira_skeleton_second_narrator_1.speaker: narrator
caira_skeleton_second_narrator_1.text: You wonder if taking the trinket is a good idea.

aiden_skeleton_narrator_1.speaker: narrator
aiden_skeleton_narrator_1.text: The boy looked very young, and you can't help but notice that his body hasn't been here as long as the others.

aiden_skeleton_rowyn_4.speaker: rowyn
aiden_skeleton_rowyn_4.text: Aiden disappeared from Lunara a few months ago.

aiden_skeleton_rowyn_5.speaker: rowyn
aiden_skeleton_rowyn_5.text: We searched for weeks. His mother hasn't left her house since the search was called off.
